CustomField.description: Custom filter conditions evaluated against Case fields during rule matching. Supports AND-combined conditions. Any standard or custom Case field API name can be used — fields are automatically added to the batch query at runtime.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter conditions combined with AND. Syntax: Field = 'Value', Field != 'Value', Field = null, Field != null, Field LIKE 'Pattern%', Field IN ('A','B'), Field NOT IN ('A','B'), Field = true/false. OR is not supported. Use the field API name (e.g. Secondary_Call_Reason__c, OwnerId, Priority). Relationship fields like Owner.Name and RecordType.DeveloperName are also available.
CustomField.label: Additional Filter Logic
